chunks: And from one of his sermons (peace be upon him), and in it are subtle discussions from Divine Knowledge.
ai.seo_question: What is the theme of this sermon from Nahj al-Balagha regarding Divine attributes?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a sermon in Nahj al-Balagha where Imam Ali (AS) elucidates the attributes of God, specifically focusing on Divine Knowledge (al-'Ilm al-Ilahi). In Shia theological tradition, this section is significant for establishing the eternity and comprehensiveness of God's knowledge, distinguishing it from created knowledge and affirming His absolute perfection. The 'subtle discussions' (mabāḥith laṭīfa) likely address how God knows all particulars and universals simultaneously without change or composition.
